mentions.name: Vectyn
mentions.description: This AI agent system, built on n8n and Airtable, walks businesses through a growth framework instead of open-ended chat. It outlines tactics and generates deliverables matched to the company and its target market rather than generic content, with human-in-the-loop review available at key moments. It is functional but not yet formally launched, and is not designed for startups.
mentions.problem: Open-ended AI chat yields generic content instead of structured, company-specific growth guidance.
mentions.audience: Businesses and companies seeking growth guidance; explicitly not designed for startups
mentions.source_excerpt: Am a solo founder building an n8n/Airtable-backed agent system that walks businesses through a growth framework instead of open-ended chat. It outlines tactics and generates deliverables matched to the company and its target market. Not generic content. Human in the loop is available at key moments if needed.
mentions.author: n8n_and_coffee
